notes: SPOUSE'S TITLE DOES NOT MATCH DOCUMENTED HOLDER (research 2026-07-03): this tree names her husband (I182381537279) "David Lindsay, 9th Earl of Crawford," but the real, documented 9th Earl of Crawford died in 1558 (Wikipedia; FamilySearch L5ZW-QTL; WikiTree Lindsay-484; thepeerage.com) — nearly 80 years before this couple's recorded dates. A later David Lindsay of Edzell (1636-1698) is associated with a wife named Jean Innes in some secondary genealogy sites, but which (if any) documented Lindsay generation he actually belongs to is unresolved; the "9th Earl of Crawford" label should not be repeated as fact without a proper peerage citation (e.g., Scots Peerage).
